lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend about a hotel stay. Say where you stay.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Anna, I want to tell you about a hotel stay by the sea. I stay at a bed and breakfast with my mother. The hotel has free Wi-Fi. We meet in the foyer at nine. The lounge is at the end of the corridor. I like this hotel. I can use hotel English in a new situation. The bed and breakfast is nice. Please tell me what you think. Best, Emma
lessons.sound: Foyer has its strongest beat on FOY. In foyer, say FOY clearly at the start. In corridor, say CORR clearly at the start.
lessons.model: We meet in the foyer at nine.
lessons.wordSample: She stays at a bed and breakfast by the sea.

transferCheck.source: On Tuesday, Emma visits her teacher, Ms. Green. Emma says, 'I can use hotel English in a new situation. I stay at a bed and breakfast by the sea with my mother.' Ms. Green says, 'Good. What is the hotel like?' Emma says, 'The hotel has free Wi-Fi. We meet in the foyer at nine.' Ms. Green says, 'Very good. Is the lounge at the end of the corridor?' Emma says, 'Yes. The lounge is at the end of the corridor.' Ms. Green says, 'Good. You use hotel English well.'
transferCheck.dictation: We stay at a bed and breakfast by the sea.
